evidence: The clean Si(1 0 0)-(2 · 1) surface was exposed to increasing amounts of HfI4 at two different temperatures, 870 and 1120 K. In neither case was iodine detected on the surface, as expected from the annealing series discussed above. The final Hf coverage was estimated to be similar for the two temperatures. The attenuation of the Si 2p signal indicates coverages in the submonolayer–monolayer regime.
